title: Scully says Dr. G is no longer available

tellings.quote: And Scully says, "Oh, that won't be possible. Uh, we uh what was the He's no longer available."

plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsay tells on Jesse Michels' podcast of a 1950 moment at a Chicago radio station involving Frank Scully, a writer who claimed knowledge of crashed flying saucers, and a man named John Torrance Tate. Ramsay says that when Scully was asked to bring forward his scientist source, known as Dr. G, Scully replied that it would not be possible because Dr. G was "no longer available." The moment matters to Ramsay because it bears on whether Scully's source could ever be checked.
